summary: The round 1 fixes are tight. The reviewer's new Version bullet reads the base branch with the wrapper's `pr` output, which carries `baseRefName`, and it relies on the post moving an unanchored comment into the review body, which the workflow does. Its exception covers this PR's deliberate 0.1.0. The README release order now matches Task 8, and the setup header lists the plugin.json exit-2 case. One problem remains in the R1-3 rewording: in four places it credits the plan approver with keeping the guard and hook files out of a cached-mode run, but the approver has no such check. This repository has no scheduled or queued work that touches the changed files.

findings.title: Corrected docs credit the plan approver with a guard-file check it does not have
findings.description: The R1-3 rewording says that when a run loads a cached release, "point 11 ..., the plan approver and the teammate's review" keep `scripts/redline-guard.sh` and `hooks/hooks.json` out of a run. The fix diff makes the same claim in four places: README.md:221, CLAUDE.md:57, point 11 at .claude/commands/agent-os/shape-spec.md:70, and agent-os/standards/scripts/guard.md:9. agents/redline-plan-approver.md has no check that names either file. Check 5 (file scope, line 20) bounces tasks under "the Redline plugin's own directory", which in cached mode is the cache directory, not the checkout. The round's own shape.md (Investigation, line 51) records this. The workflow (workflows/redline-loop.js) passes no guard-file rule to any role. The checker's allowed list is the approved plan, so a planned edit of either file would pass it too. The approver could catch such a task only indirectly, through check 7 and the guard.md standard, and that standard now cites the approver as the protection, which is circular. The decision behind R1-3 was that the docs should say what the code does. These four sentences still name a safeguard that does not exist, and a reader who relies on them overrates what stands behind the precheck warning.
findings.proposedFix: Remove "the plan approver" from the four sentences. README.md:221 then reads "only point 11 of the unattended section in `.claude/commands/agent-os/shape-spec.md` and the teammate's review keep a change to them out of a run". In CLAUDE.md:57 and shape-spec.md:70 (point 11), only point 11 / "this point" keeps them out of a plan. In agent-os/standards/scripts/guard.md:9, only point 11 of the unattended section keeps the two files out of a plan. Alternatively, make the claim true: add a sentence to check 5 of agents/redline-plan-approver.md that bounces a task changing `scripts/redline-guard.sh` or `hooks/hooks.json` when the repository's `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` names `redline`, and sends that finding back as `defer`. Then name that check in a Docs entry. No harness reads a role's prompt, so either fix is proven with grep counts.
